audio/voice/sif/sif_revised_black-r2.ogg.text: 空白的区域，也能成为立足之处。
audio/voice/sif/sif_revised_black-r2.ogg.speaker: zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural

audio/voice/sif/sif_revised_black-r3.ogg.text: 支配区域的积累，会化为新的力量。
audio/voice/sif/sif_revised_black-r3.ogg.speaker: zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural

audio/voice/ja/sif/sif_revised_black-r1..text: 迷宮を力に変え、仲間を帰還させましょう。
audio/voice/ja/sif/sif_revised_black-r1..speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/sif/sif_revised_black-r2..text: 何もない地域も、足場にできます。
audio/voice/ja/sif/sif_revised_black-r2..speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/sif/sif_revised_black-r3..text: 支配した地域の積み重ねを、力にしましょう。
audio/voice/ja/sif/sif_revised_black-r3..speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_white-r1.text: 三、六、九，这些费用可别错过！
audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_white-r1.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_white-r2.text: 收入和商业标记，一起到手！
audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_white-r2.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_white-r3.text: 看看酒馆里的冒险者，这下有回报啦！
audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_white-r3.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_white.text: 三、六、九。この費用は見逃せないね！
audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_white.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_white.text: 収入も商売の印も、いっぺんにもらおう！
audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_white.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_white.text: 酒場の冒険者を見て。いい見返りがあるよ！
audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_white.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_black-r1.text: 战力成长的时候，也别忘了收金币！
audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_black-r1.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_black-r2.text: 调整收入，把战力供给提上去！
audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_black-r2.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_black-r3.text: 有了名声更高的领地，力量也更足！
audio/voice/frida/frida_revised_black-r3.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_black.text: 戦力が育ったら、お金も忘れずにね！
audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_black.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_black.text: 収入を調整して、戦力の供給を増やそう！
audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_black.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_black.text: 名声の高い領地があれば、力も十分さ！
audio/voice/ja/frida/frida_revised_black.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_wh.text: 把力量用起来，换成新的金币。
audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_wh.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_wh.text: 这份力量，也请各位一起收下。
audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_wh.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_wh.text: 再多行动一步，让努力继续开花。
audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_wh.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/intro-v1.ogg.text: ベル、いつでも力になれるよ。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/intro-v1.ogg.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/intro-v2.ogg.text: ギルドマスター、力が必要なら呼んでね。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/intro-v2.ogg.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/select-white.text: 力があれば、新しい価値を生み出せる。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/select-white.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/select-white.text: 頑張るなら、意味のあるところでね。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/select-white.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-first-.text: 先に閉めて、力を回復してくるね。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-first-.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-first-.text: 今日は十分収穫があったよ。休もう。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-first-.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-last-v.text: 最後の収穫も、持ち帰れたよ。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-last-v.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-last-v.text: 確認できたから、閉めようか。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-last-v.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-shop-v.text: お疲れさま。今季の努力も実ったね。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-shop-v.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-shop-v.text: 成果をしまって、次も続けよう。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/close-shop-v.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/settle-win-v.text: 私たちの力が、勝利につながったね！
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/settle-win-v.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/settle-win-v.text: ギルドマスター、信じてくれてありがとう。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/settle-win-v.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/settle-lose-.text: まだ力があるなら、次もあるよ。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/settle-lose-.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/settle-lose-.text: まず立て直そう。ここで止まったりしないから。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/settle-lose-.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.text: 力を使って、新しい資金に変えよう。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.text: この力は、みんなにも受け取ってほしいな。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.text: もう一歩動いて、努力を実らせよう。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_bl.text: 迷宫的名声，也能带来秘药。
audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_bl.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_bl.text: 新的力量已经准备好，继续前进。
audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_bl.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_bl.text: 这次探索，让我来为你打开道路。
audio/voice/bell_revised/bell_revised_bl.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/select-red-v.text: 迷宮の収穫は、私が預かるよ。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/select-red-v.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/select-red-v.text: 前へ進めば、新しい成果が見つかるよ。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/select-red-v.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.text: 迷宮の名声は、秘薬にもなるよ。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.text: 新しい力も用意できた。前に進もう。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.text: 今度の探索は、私が道を開くよ。
audio/voice/ja/bell_revised/bell_revised.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_white-r1.text: 懒散生活，也是认真安排出来的嘛。
audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_white-r1.speaker: zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural

audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_white-r2.text: 日子舒服了，收入也该提高一些。
audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_white-r2.speaker: zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural

audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_white-r3.text: 伙伴们回来啦，这回该我认真冒险了。
audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_white-r3.speaker: zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural

audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_white.text: のんびり暮らすにも、ちゃんと準備がいるんだよ。
audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_white.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_white.text: 暮らしが楽になったら、収入も増やそうか。
audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_white.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_white.text: みんな戻ったね。今度は私が冒険する番かな。
audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_white.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_black-r1.text: 挑一条合适的路，轻松一点去探索吧。
audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_black-r1.speaker: zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural

audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_black-r2.text: 力量和零件准备好了，不用太着急。
audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_black-r2.speaker: zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural

audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_black-r3.text: 把合适的领地，直接变成据点吧。
audio/voice/marta/marta_revised_black-r3.speaker: zh-TW-HsiaoYuNeural

audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_black.text: いい道を選んで、楽に探索しようよ。
audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_black.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_black.text: 力も部品も揃ったね。慌てなくていいよ。
audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_black.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_black.text: ちょうどいい領地を、そのまま拠点にしよう。
audio/voice/ja/marta/marta_revised_black.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_white-r1.o.text: 生活、商业与零件凑齐，收益就有了。
audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_white-r1.o.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_white-r2.o.text: 挑选合适的情报，舍去多余的负担。
audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_white-r2.o.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_white-r3.o.text: 把三种标记的积累，一起转成收益。
audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_white-r3.o.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_white-r.text: 暮らし、商売、部品。揃えば利益になります。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_white-r.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_white-r.text: よい情報を選び、余分な負担を捨てましょう。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_white-r.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_white-r.text: 三つの印の積み重ねを、まとめて収益にしましょう。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_white-r.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_five_white-r1.ogg.text: 三种标记成组，积累就能兑现。
audio/voice/horn/horn_five_white-r1.ogg.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_five_white-r2.ogg.text: 情报不是越多越好，要仔细选择。
audio/voice/horn/horn_five_white-r2.ogg.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_five_white-r3.ogg.text: 清点生活、商业与零件，收下回报吧。
audio/voice/horn/horn_five_white-r3.ogg.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_five_white-r1.o.text: 三つの印を一組にして、成果を受け取りましょう。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_five_white-r1.o.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_five_white-r2.o.text: 情報は多ければよいとは限りません。よく選んで。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_five_white-r2.o.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_five_white-r3.o.text: 暮らしと商売と部品を数え、報酬を受け取りましょう。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_five_white-r3.o.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_black-r1.o.text: 先把事件背面放好，增加战力供给。
audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_black-r1.o.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_black-r2.o.text: 新的情报和零件，已经备妥。
audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_black-r2.o.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_black-r3.o.text: 把准备好的事件翻开，正式实施计划。
audio/voice/horn/horn_revised_black-r3.o.speaker: zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_black-r.text: まず札を裏向きに置いて、戦力供給を増やします。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_black-r.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_black-r.text: 新しい情報も部品も、準備できました。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_black-r.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural

audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_black-r.text: 用意した札を表にして、計画を実行しましょう。
audio/voice/ja/horn/horn_revised_black-r.speaker: ja-JP-NanamiNeural
